steps.text:
Modern medicine offers various methods to improve the appearance of scarring, even for scars that are several years old, such as the extensive scarring described on the forearm from 15 years ago. While complete "healing" or removal of scars may not always be possible, significant improvements can often be achieved through a combination of surgical and non-surgical treatments.

One of the common surgical methods used to address scars is skin grafting, where healthy skin is transplanted to the scarred area. This can help in cases where scars are severe and restrict mobility or cause discomfort.
